categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient via pathway A, advancing the softgoal to avoid post-discharge deterioration and being measured against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release A (id 17), observed across multiple variants such as V0008, V0070, and V0069.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient via pathway B, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and evaluated against post-discharge ER return rates.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release B (id 18), observed in narrative variant V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient via pathway C, contributing to post-discharge stability and measured via downstream ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release C (id 19), observed in complex variant V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient via pathway D, advancing the organization's objective of preventing post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release D (id 20), observed in variant V0273.
